blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) volleyball tournament moves to Minglanilla this weekend for the high school division semifinals and finals. Cesafi officials, led by commissioner Felix Tiukinhoy, announced that the matches will be played on Saturday, November 14, and Sunday, November 15. In the girls’ division, top seed University of Southern Philippines Foundation (USPF) will take on No. 4 University of Cebu Lapu-Lapu and Mandaue (UCLM) in the first semifinal match on Saturday. The match will follow the ongoing women’s elimination round game between the University of San Carlos (USC) and UCLM at 8:30 a.m. […]...
